title: Gluing derived complexes and compatible morphisms on two opens
statement: Let (X,\mathcal O_X) be a ringed space [def-pc-derived-category] with X=U\cup V. Given A\in D(\mathcal O_U), B\in D(\mathcal O_V), and an isomorphism c:A|_{U\cap V}\xrightarrow{\sim}B|_{U\cap V}, there is F\in D(\mathcal O_X) restricting to A and B with transition c. Given E\in D(\mathcal O_X) and compatible maps a:A\to E|_U and b:B\to E|_V (a|_{U\cap V}=b|_{U\cap V}\circ c), there is a map F\to E restricting to a and b.

proof.text: Apply derived_open_gluing_objects to obtain F and its two local isomorphisms with the prescribed transition.

For compatible a,b, map composition through the overlap functors. Rewrite by the compatibility equation, compose the transition equation with the restricted b and target comparison, and reassociate. This gives overlap compatibility of iU.hom followed by a and iV.hom followed by b.
Apply scheme_derived_hom_gluing to this compatible pair, obtaining the required global f and both restriction equations.
